strategies.name: SPY Buy and Hold
strategies.summary: Buys SPY on the first day and holds it to the end. This is the benchmark the other strategies are compared against.
strategies.entry_rules: Long on every bar, starting from the first bar.
strategies.exit_rules: Never sells, except at the end of the test.
strategies.weaknesses: Takes the full market drop with no protection. Only runs on SPY.

strategies.name: EMA Cross
strategies.summary: Goes long when a fast moving average rises above a slow one, and short when it falls below.
strategies.entry_rules: Long when EMA(9) is above EMA(21). Short when EMA(9) is below EMA(21).
strategies.exit_rules: The position flips when the averages cross back.
strategies.weaknesses: Whipsaws in sideways markets. Lags after sharp moves.

strategies.name: RSI Reversion
strategies.summary: Buys after RSI shows a stock has fallen too far too fast, and sells once it recovers to the middle. Shorts the opposite when RSI is stretched high.
strategies.entry_rules: Long when RSI(14) closes below 30. Short when RSI(14) closes above 70.
strategies.exit_rules: Close a long when RSI rises above 50. Close a short when RSI falls below 50.
strategies.weaknesses: Strong trends keep RSI pinned high or low, so it can enter early and keep losing. Slow to exit after a sharp reversal.

strategies.name: Donchian Breakout
strategies.summary: Buys when price breaks above its highest high of the last 20 days, and goes short when it breaks below the lowest low.
strategies.entry_rules: Long when the close is above the highest high of the previous 20 bars. Short when the close is below the lowest low of the previous 20 bars.
strategies.exit_rules: Close a long when the close drops below the lowest low of the previous 10 bars. Close a short when the close rises above the highest high of the previous 10 bars.
strategies.weaknesses: Sideways markets trigger false breakouts and repeated small losses.

strategies.name: 200-Day Trend
strategies.summary: Holds the stock while it trades above its 200-day average, and stays in cash while it trades below.
strategies.entry_rules: Long when the close is above the 200-day simple moving average.
strategies.exit_rules: Sell when the close falls below the 200-day simple moving average.
strategies.weaknesses: Slow to get out after a crash and slow to get back in. Gets whipsawed when price hovers around the average.

strategies.name: Bollinger Reversion
strategies.summary: Buys when a stock drops well below its recent average, and sells once it climbs back to that average.
strategies.entry_rules: Long when the close falls below the 20-day average minus 2 standard deviations. Long only.
strategies.exit_rules: Sell when the close rises back above the 20-day average. Also sells at a 5% stop-loss below the entry price.
strategies.weaknesses: In a steady downtrend, price keeps falling below the band. The stop limits the loss but also cuts some recoveries short.

strategies.name: 6-Month Momentum
strategies.summary: Goes long a stock that is higher than it was about six months ago, and short one that is lower.
strategies.entry_rules: Long when the close is above the close 126 bars (about 6 months) ago. Short when it is below.
strategies.exit_rules: The position flips when the sign of that comparison changes.
strategies.weaknesses: Trend reversals cause repeated losses. Sharp rallies hurt the short side badly.

strategies.name: RSI(2) Pullback
strategies.summary: Buys a short dip in an uptrend, once the stock is very oversold for a day or two, and sells on the bounce.
strategies.entry_rules: Long when the close is above the 200-day average and the 2-day RSI is below 10. Long only.
strategies.exit_rules: Sell when the close is above the 5-day average.
strategies.weaknesses: Pullbacks in a bear market can turn into long declines. Works best on stocks that bounce quickly.

strategies.name: Inside Bar Breakout
strategies.summary: After a bar whose range sits fully inside the bar before it, buys a break above the bigger bar's high and shorts a break below its low.
strategies.entry_rules: Long when the close breaks above the high of the bar before the inside bar. Short when it breaks below that bar's low.
strategies.exit_rules: Stays in the last direction until the opposite break happens (always in the market).
strategies.weaknesses: Inside bars are common in quiet markets, and breakouts there often fail quickly.

strategies.name: Engulfing Reversal
strategies.summary: Buys after a bullish candle swallows the body of the bearish candle before it, and shorts after the reverse pattern.
strategies.entry_rules: Long on a bullish engulfing candle: green body covers the previous red body. Short on a bearish engulfing candle.
strategies.exit_rules: Reverses on the opposite pattern. Also sells at a 3% stop-loss.
strategies.weaknesses: Engulfing candles happen often in choppy markets, and many reversals don't hold.

strategies.name: Pin Bar Reversal
strategies.summary: Buys when a candle has a long lower wick and closes near its high, showing buyers pushed the price back up. Shorts the mirror image.
strategies.entry_rules: Long when the lower wick is at least twice the body and the close is in the top third of the bar. Short when the upper wick is at least twice the body and the close is in the bottom third.
strategies.exit_rules: Sells after 3 bars, or when the position is flat. Holds for a fixed time.
strategies.weaknesses: Rejection wicks are common on volatile days with no real reversal behind them.

strategies.name: Gap Fade
strategies.summary: When a stock opens more than 1% below the previous close, buys and waits for the gap to fill.
strategies.entry_rules: Long at the close of a day that opened more than 1% below the prior close. Long only.
strategies.exit_rules: Sells once the close reaches the prior close (gap filled), or after 3 bars.
strategies.weaknesses: Gaps that come from bad news often keep falling. The gap may never fill.

strategies.name: Regression Channel Breakout
strategies.summary: Fits a trendline through the last 50 days. When the trend is up and price breaks above the top of the channel, buys. When the trend is down and price breaks below the bottom, shorts.
strategies.entry_rules: Long when the 50-day trend slope is up and the close is above the channel top (trendline plus 2 standard deviations). Short on the reverse.
strategies.exit_rules: Closes when price crosses back through the middle trendline.
strategies.weaknesses: Channels get redrawn as new bars come in, so breakouts can appear and disappear. Fails in flat markets.

strategies.name: Keltner Channel Breakout
strategies.summary: Draws a channel two average true ranges above and below a 20-day average. Buys when price closes above the top band, shorts below the bottom band.
strategies.entry_rules: Long when the close is above the 20-day average plus 2 ATR. Short when below the average minus 2 ATR.
strategies.exit_rules: Closes when price crosses back through the 20-day average.
strategies.weaknesses: Breakouts that happen during a volatility spike reverse quickly. Chops in sideways markets.

strategies.name: Supertrend
strategies.summary: Draws a trailing stop line that rises in an uptrend and falls in a downtrend. Goes long when price is above the line, and short when it is below.
strategies.entry_rules: Long while the close is above the Supertrend line. Short while it is below.
strategies.exit_rules: Flips direction when the close crosses the line. Always in the market.
strategies.weaknesses: Whipsaws in sideways markets, flipping direction after small moves.

strategies.name: MACD Crossover
strategies.summary: Buys when the fast momentum line (MACD) crosses above its smoothed signal line, and shorts when it crosses below.
strategies.entry_rules: Long while MACD is above its 9-day signal line. Short while it is below. (12, 26, 9 settings.)
strategies.exit_rules: Flips when the lines cross. Always in the market.
strategies.weaknesses: Late signals: most of the move is over by the time the lines cross. Whipsaws in ranges.

strategies.name: Volume Breakout
strategies.summary: Buys when price breaks above its 20-day high on volume at least 1.5 times normal. Heavy volume suggests real buying interest, not just drift.
strategies.entry_rules: Long when the close is above the highest high of the last 20 bars, and today's volume is over 1.5 times the 20-day average. Long only.
strategies.exit_rules: Sells when the close falls below the lowest low of the last 10 bars.
strategies.weaknesses: Volume data here comes from the IEX feed only, which is a small share of all trading, so the volume signal is noisier than it would be with full market volume.

strategies.name: OBV Trend
strategies.summary: Tracks On-Balance Volume, which adds volume on up days and subtracts it on down days. When that total is above its 20-day average, the trend is up, and the strategy is long.
strategies.entry_rules: Long when OBV is above its 20-day average. Short when it is below.
strategies.exit_rules: Flips when OBV crosses its average. Always in the market after warm-up.
strategies.weaknesses: Uses the IEX volume feed, which is a small share of all trading, so the signal is noisier. Price and volume can disagree for long stretches.

strategies.name: Volume Climax Bounce
strategies.summary: When a down day comes with panic volume and the close recovers into the upper half of the day's range, buys the bounce and holds for a few days.
strategies.entry_rules: Long on a day that closes lower than the day before, on volume at least 2 times the 20-day average, with the close in the top half of the day's range.
strategies.exit_rules: Sells after 3 bars. Long only.
strategies.weaknesses: A panic day can be the start of a longer crash. Also uses IEX volume, which is noisier than full market volume.

strategies.name: Stochastic Cross
strategies.summary: Watches where the close sits within its 14-day range. Buys when the fast line crosses above the slow line from oversold territory, and shorts the reverse from overbought.
strategies.entry_rules: Long when %K crosses above %D while %K is below 30. Short when %K crosses below %D while %K is above 70.
strategies.exit_rules: Closes when the lines cross back the other way.
strategies.weaknesses: In a strong trend, the stock stays overbought or oversold for a long time and signals fire too early.

strategies.name: Williams %R Revert
strategies.summary: Measures where the close sits in its 14-day range. When it is near the bottom, buys, and sells once it climbs back to the middle.
strategies.entry_rules: Long when Williams %R is below -90 (close near the bottom of the 14-day range). Long only.
strategies.exit_rules: Sells when %R rises above -50. Also sells at a 4% stop-loss.
strategies.weaknesses: A stock in a strong downtrend stays at the bottom of its range, and the strategy keeps buying into the fall.

strategies.name: ADX Trend Strength
strategies.summary: Measures how strong the trend is (ADX). Only trades when the trend is strong, long in an uptrend and short in a downtrend, and stays flat when the market has no clear trend.
strategies.entry_rules: Long when ADX is above 25 and the upward direction index (+DI) is above the downward one (-DI). Short on the reverse. Flat when ADX is below 25.
strategies.exit_rules: Goes flat when ADX falls below 25 or the direction indexes cross.
strategies.weaknesses: ADX reacts slowly, so it often confirms a trend after much of it is over.

strategies.name: Low-Volatility Trend
strategies.summary: Holds a stock only when it is above its 100-day average and its recent daily swings are calmer than its typical level over the past year. Stays in cash otherwise.
strategies.entry_rules: Long when the close is above the 100-day average and the 60-day volatility is below its one-year median. Long only.
strategies.exit_rules: Sells when either condition stops being true. Holds only in calm uptrends.
strategies.weaknesses: Sits out a lot of the time, so it can miss strong moves. Calm markets can turn into fast crashes, and the strategy may be slow to get out.

strategies.name: Calm Market Hold
strategies.summary: Holds a stock only while its recent volatility is among the calmest 40% of the past year and it is above its 50-day average. Stays in cash otherwise.
strategies.entry_rules: Long when the 20-day volatility is at or below its 40th percentile over the past year and the close is above the 50-day average. Long only.
strategies.exit_rules: Sells when either condition stops being true.
strategies.weaknesses: Calm periods often end with a sudden spike in volatility, and this strategy only reacts after it starts. Sits out many rallies.

strategies.name: Bull Flag Breakout
strategies.summary: After a sharp rise, waits for a tight sideways pause (the flag). Buys when price breaks above the top of that pause.
strategies.entry_rules: Long when the stock rose over 8% in the 10 bars before the flag, the last 5 bars stayed within 4% of price, and the close breaks above the flag's high. Long only.
strategies.exit_rules: Sells when the close falls below its 10-day average.
strategies.weaknesses: Many flags fail and turn into reversals. The pattern is subjective when drawn by hand; this version uses fixed rules.
